capability_gain: Searches a frozen compositional representation grammar from raw transition observations without receiving the hidden target transform.
Uses reliability-weighted partial/noisy verifier evidence instead of treating every response as infallible.
Chooses disagreement-heavy evidence actively under a fixed query budget.
Abstains on non-identifiable cases rather than forcing a library mutation.
Uses independent counterexamples to reject coherent common-mode verifier corruption.
Bridges accepted representations into R2.18 reuse/create/split/abstain governance without modifying the sealed governor.
claim_boundary: Bounded generated 3-bit transition systems inside a frozen permutation/complement/direction grammar. The result does not establish autonomous invention of new representation operators, unrestricted representation learning, frontier-model parity, or AGI.
milestone: R2.19 Autonomous Representation Discovery under Partial/Noisy Verification
next_falsifiable_milestone: R2.20 Autonomous Representation-Language Synthesis: infer or synthesize new representation operators for out-of-grammar tasks under the same noisy-verifier, abstention, library-capacity and heldout discipline.
